title: AW27 Men's Protected
summary: Big but light: oversized jackets, wide trousers and down that weigh little, heat-fused padding and hidden performance in tailoring.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The story
sections.body: Edwin van den Hoek's "Protected" theme: jackets, trousers and down grow bigger without weight, "It looks very big, but it is very light to wear" <sup>[1]</sup>. He describes heat-fused padded structures without stitching that stay waterproof <sup>[1]</sup>. Première Vision's suitings hide membranes and bi-stretch <sup>[2]</sup>. Agelink points to parka-hooded raincoats and padded windbreakers <sup>[3]</sup>.

sections.heading: Colours
sections.body: Tinted black, greyed blue and copper khaki.

sections.heading: Silhouettes
sections.body:
- Oversized down and padded jackets.
- Wide trousers.
- Hooded raincoats over tailoring.

sections.heading: Fabrics
sections.body: Ultralight nylon, ripstop, membrane-backed wool, heat-fused padding.

sections.heading: Trims and details
sections.body: Bonded seams, concealed zips, rubberised webbing.
